title: 第一卷 第6章 算了，你看起来也没读
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋尔尔把吐司放进烤面包机。

刚按下去，身后传来顾南舟的声音。

“早。”

宋尔尔没回头：“早。”

顾南舟走进厨房，看见她在烤吐司，又看了眼冰箱。

“你没喝牛奶？”

宋尔尔：“没。”

顾南舟拿起自己的咖啡，语气像是在缓和关系：“我记得你以前早上不喜欢吃太干的东西。”

姜眠默默低头。

她觉得自己站在这里像多余的叉子。

宋尔尔把烤好的吐司拿出来，涂花生酱。

“那你记错了。”

顾南舟：“我怎么会记错？”

宋尔尔看他：“你连还钱都能忘，记错这个很正常。”

顾南舟表情一僵。

姜眠差点把吐司掰断。

这时，厨房门口又来人了。

林栀穿着浅色针织衫，头发松松扎着，看起来很居家。

她先和大家打招呼：“早呀。”

顾南舟的表情缓和了一点：“早。”

林栀看见宋尔尔和姜眠手里的吐司，温柔问：“你们怎么只吃这个？冰箱里不是有牛奶和酸奶吗？”

姜眠小声说：“上面都有名字。”

林栀愣了一下，立刻笑：“没关系呀，我的酸奶你们可以喝。”

姜眠有点受宠若惊：“谢谢林栀姐。”

宋尔尔没接。

林栀看着她：“尔尔姐不喝吗？”

宋尔尔：“不喝。”

林栀表情微微一顿：“你是不是还在因为昨天的事情不高兴？”

宋尔尔看着她。

厨房里安静了一点。

林栀这句话很轻，但很容易让人误会。

像是宋尔尔还在闹脾气。

顾南舟也看了过来。

宋尔尔拿着吐司，咬了一口，才慢悠悠开口。

“不是。”

林栀松了口气。

宋尔尔：“我乳糖不耐。”

林栀：“……”

姜眠：“……”

顾南舟：“……”

宋尔尔又补一句：“昨天忘了说，今天补充人设。”

厨房门口传来一声很轻的笑。

宋尔尔回头。

陆执站在那里，手里拿着一袋早餐。

他大概刚回来，外套还没脱。

林栀立刻调整表情：“陆老师早。”

顾南舟也点了下头。

Page (1/3)

Songer put the toast into the toaster.

Just as he pressed it, Gu Nanzhou's voice came from behind.

"Morning."

Song Er'er didn't look back: "Morning."

Gu Nanzhou walked into the kitchen and saw her baking toast, then looked at the refrigerator.

"You didn't drink milk?"

Song Er'er: "No."

Gu Nanzhou picked up his coffee and said in a tone that seemed to be easing the relationship: "I remember that you didn't like eating anything too dry in the morning."

Jiang Mian lowered his head silently.

She felt like she was standing here like an unnecessary fork.

Song Er'er took out the toast and spread peanut butter on it.

"Then you remembered it wrong."

Gu Nanzhou: "How could I remember it wrong?"

Song Er'er looked at him: "You can even forget to pay back the money. It's normal to remember this wrong."

Gu Nanzhou's expression froze.

Jiang Mian almost broke the toast.

At this time, someone came to the kitchen door again.

Lin Zhi wore a light-colored sweater and her hair was tied loosely, looking very at home.

She greeted everyone first: "Good morning."

Gu Nanzhou's expression softened a little: "Morning."

Lin Zhi saw the toast in Song Er'er and Jiang Mian's hands and asked gently: "Why do you only eat this? Isn't there milk and yogurt in the refrigerator?"

Jiang Mian whispered: "There are names on them."

Lin Zhi was stunned for a moment, then immediately smiled: "It's okay, you can drink my yogurt."

Jiang Mian was a little flattered: "Thank you, Sister Lin Zhi."

Song Er'er didn't answer.

Lin Zhi looked at her: "Sister Er'er, don't you want to drink?"

Song Er'er: "Don't drink."

Lin Zhi's expression paused slightly: "Are you still unhappy because of what happened yesterday?"

Song Er looked at her.

The kitchen was a little quieter.

Lin Zhi's words were very light, but they could easily be misunderstood.

It seemed like Song Er'er was still having a temper.

Gu Nanzhou also looked over.

Song Er'er took the toast and took a bite before speaking slowly.

"No."

Lin Zhi breathed a sigh of relief.

Song Er'er: "I'm lactose intolerant."

Lin Zhi: "..."

Jiang Mian: "..."

Gu Nanzhou: "..."

Song Er'er added: "I forgot to mention it yesterday, so I will add the character today."

A soft laugh came from the kitchen door.

Song Er'er turned around.

Lu Zhi stood there with a bag of breakfast in his hand.

He probably just came back, and he still hasn't taken off his coat.

Lin Zhi immediately adjusted his expression: "Good morning, Teacher Lu."

Gu Nanzhou also nodded.
